title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Journal Club Printout. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Journal Club Printout
options.lineage: the photocopied article a colleague already marked up for journal club
options.thesis: Every answer reads like a printout someone checked for you: claims highlighted, sources annotated in the margin.
materials: laser print on bright copy paper
options.viewport: Ballpoint-blue history rail; question as the printout title; answer at reading measure; an evidence margin of numbered source cards beside it.
options.signature: Highlighter sweep: hovering or tapping a citation sweeps highlighter over its claim and lights the matching margin card in the same ink.
options.risk: Highlighter colour turns playful if it marks anything but evidence links and evidence strength.

raised.raise: Every source carries fixed furniture: evidence level, year and a one-line finding under its title.
Nothing is labelled twice: one badge per fact, origin folded into the byline.
On a phone the active citation's source opens in focus with the reference count kept in view; the margin never shrinks to unreadable chips.
One strict type scale: the reading face at four sizes, nothing in between.
Tabular numerals for every year, dose, effect size and CI; every highlight passes AA contrast.

options.label: Summary of Findings
options.lineage: GRADE summary-of-findings tables and forest plots
options.thesis: Evidence strength drawn the way evidence synthesis draws it: certainty marks and effect rows beside every claim.
options.viewport: Answer column left; a summary-of-findings table right, each cited source a row with design, size, effect and certainty.
options.signature: Certainty strip: each claim shows GRADE-style certainty marks and a mini forest-plot whisker for its pooled effect.
options.risk: The most familiar evidence-tool look, where most runs in this category land; a dense table is heavy on a phone.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.lineage: scholarly editions set by a ruling engine
options.thesis: The answer set like a critical edition: citation keys in a vermilion rail, sources hung in a wide margin.
options.viewport: Narrow answer block with a centre rail of citation keys; source apparatus in the right margin.
options.case: Fuses cleanly, keys map to citations and the margin holds sources; loses on audience identification, clinicians read journals, not critical editions.
options.risk: Bone paper, serif and vermilion is a common AI default and reads antiquarian on a ward phone.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: The search pipeline and thread drawn as transit lines with stations and interchanges.
options.viewport: Midnight shell with the answer's sources as interchange stations.
options.case: Fuses poorly: clinicians do not read evidence as journeys, and the map competes with the answer.
options.kept: Focus the active corridor without shrinking context: the phone source view.
options.risk: A map costume on a reading screen.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every source a catalog number, labels encoded as colour strips.
options.viewport: Black field, answer in white, sources as coded strips.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hiding labels behind colour codes fails clinicians checking evidence fast.
options.risk: Coded state is illegible at the point of care.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Answers set as a type specimen with pixel display faces.
options.viewport: Pixel headline over dense justified columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pixel display type works against fast clinical reading.
options.risk: Novelty type on a trust tool.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Evidence as barcode bars and sine lattices in pure black and white.
options.viewport: Barcode field with the answer in monospace.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strobing data art distracts from reading an answer.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Sources as a ranked roster of cards with name plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful pastels undercut clinical trust.
options.kept: Fixed furniture on every item: a one-line finding under each source.
options.risk: Consumer cuteness on a clinical tool.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The AI answer-engine layout clinicians already know, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centred question box; chat-style answer with numbered sources listed underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other answer engine, with the evidence below the fold.
